notes: Digital mixing console (72 mono + 8 stereo input channels processed, 24 mix buses, 8 matrices) — desktop/console form factor, not rack-mountable, so rackUnits omitted. Most channel inputs are delivered via Dante from external Rio input racks, not on the console itself; only the fixed rear-panel connectors below are physically on the CL5 chassis. GPI (5in/5out) is a real D-Sub 15-pin control connector; no matching id exists in the allowed connector list, so it was mapped to the closest physical shape, "vga" (DE-15) — it is NOT a video port. The 3 gooseneck LAMP connectors are XLR-4-31 DC power outputs, mapped to "xlr4-dc" as the closest match. AC IN is Yamaha's proprietary "V-Lock" connector — a locking variant that is mechanically IEC C13/C14-compatible — mapped to "iec". Also present but not itemized as fixed ports: 3x Mini-YGDAI expansion card slots (I/O depends on installed card) and an optional external PW800W redundant power supply link (accessory cable). Dante Primary/Secondary confirmed as 1000BASE-T (Gigabit); console NETWORK control port confirmed as 10/100BASE-TX; USB Host confirmed as USB 2.0 Type-A.
